tools.name: get_succession_scan
tools.description:
Scan the book's active clients (up to 50, least-confirmed first) for incomplete succession
    planning: for each client, the succession checklist items confirmed out of those recorded for
    their household, and an urgency — NOT_STARTED when nothing is recorded, HIGH under 30% confirmed,
    MEDIU

tools.name: generate_meeting_brief
tools.description:
Build a meeting brief for one client, the same brief as Meeting Brief in the Antevo app:
    recent meetings, calls and emails; decisions of the last 90 days; open commitments; portfolio
    snapshot and performance since the last meeting; compliance notes; contact preferences; macro
    and sector

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description:
List a household's active documents, newest first (up to 50): title, file name, domain,
    category, status, type, size and whether it is sealed. Optionally filter by category, using a
    category exactly as this tool returns it.

tools.name: get_document_detail
tools.description:
Get one document's metadata — title, file name, domain, category, status, type, size, sealed,
    linked entity, account and portfolio — and how many unexpired, unrevoked share links it has.

tools.name: get_eam_clients
tools.description:
List the clients and prospects in your firm's book (up to 100, by name): type, pipeline
    stage, status, contact details, segment, tags and risk profile. Members without the whole-book
    role see only the clients assigned to them. Filter by status (ACTIVE, ARCHIVED), pipeline_stage
    (LEAD, PR

tools.name: get_client_dossier
tools.description:
Get a client's record as stored: profile, contact details, client type, pipeline stage,
    status, risk profile and tier, compliance status, review dates, notes, tags, estimated AUM and,
    once converted, the client's household_id. The assigned team is in get_client_team.

tools.name: get_client_reviews_due
tools.description:
List active clients that have a next review date, soonest first (up to 50), with the last
    review time, risk tier and days until due (negative when overdue). Pass client_id for one
    client.

tools.name: get_client_team
tools.description:
List the firm members assigned to a client: member id, assignment role (PRIMARY, ADVISOR,
    SUPPORT), whether primary, when assigned, and the member's firm role and status. Names are not
    included.

tools.name: create_eam_client
tools.description:
Add a client or prospect to your firm's book, assigned to you. client_type: INDIVIDUAL,
    FAMILY, ENTITY. pipeline_stage: LEAD, PROSPECT, NEGOTIATION, ONBOARDING. Needs confirm=true:
    the first call returns a plan.

tools.name: update_eam_client
tools.description:
Update a client's name, email, phone, notes or pipeline stage. A client becomes ACTIVE only
    through convert_prospect, and a converted (ACTIVE or CHURNED) client cannot be moved back to an
    earlier stage.

tools.name: convert_prospect
tools.description:
Convert a prospect into an active client: creates the client's household and its primary
    entity and sets the client ACTIVE, as Convert does in the Antevo app. entity_type: PERSON,
    COMPANY, TRUST, FOUNDATION (defaults from the client type). household_name defaults to the
    client's name. A

tools.name: complete_review
tools.description:
Record that a client's review is done: sets the last review to now and the next review
    date to next_review_months from today (default 12, 1 to 120). Notes, if given, are saved as an
    internal note on the client.

tools.name: assign_team_member
tools.description:
Assign a firm member to a client as PRIMARY, ADVISOR or SUPPORT; a member already assigned
    gets the new role. Assigning PRIMARY replaces the client's current primary. Needs the OWNER or
    ADMIN role in the firm.

tools.name: get_client_goals
tools.description:
Get a client's financial goals (retirement, education, property and so on), cancelled goals
    excluded, by priority: target amount, currency and date, current amount, status and priority.

tools.name: create_client_goal
update_client_goal
tools.description:
Update a client goal's current amount, status, target amount, target date (YYYY-MM-DD) or
    notes. status: ON_TRACK, AHEAD, BEHIND, AT_RISK, ACHIEVED, PAUSED, CANCELLED.

tools.name: delete_document
tools.description:
Delete a household's document: it is marked DELETED and no longer listed. Needs
    confirm=true: the first call returns a plan.

tools.name: create_share_link
tools.description:
Create a public download link to a household's document: anyone holding the link can
    download the file until it expires after expires_in_hours (default 24, at most 720 = 30 days).
    Returns the link's token and expiry. Needs confirm=true: the first call returns a plan.

tools.name: upload_document
update_document
tools.description:
Change a household document's title or category (the category as list_documents returns
    it).

tools.name: extract_document_data
tools.description:
Extracting data from a document is not available over this connector yet. Returns how to
    start an extraction instead: from the document in the Antevo app, or the REST call that reads
    portfolio positions from it into a portfolio for review. Nothing is queued or changed.

tools.name: get_email_messages
tools.description:
List email messages synced from your firm's connected mailboxes, newest first, 25 per page:
    sender, subject, preview, received time, linked client, read flag and the AI classification
    (category, priority, sentiment, summary). Members without the whole-book role see only email
    linked to c

tools.name: get_email_detail
tools.description:
Get one email you can see in your firm's synced mailboxes, with its full text and AI
    analysis — category, priority, sentiment, summary, topics, compliance flags and suggested
    action.

tools.name: link_email_to_client
tools.description:
Link an email message you can see in your firm's mailboxes to one of your firm's clients
    that you may change.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: generate_meeting_brief, get_eam_clients, get_client_dossier, get_client_reviews_due, get_email_messages, get_email_detail · Private data: generate_meeting_brief, list_documents, get_document_detail, get_eam_clients, get_client_dossier, complete_review, delete_document, create_share_link, upload_document, update_document, extract_document_data · Public sink: get_document_detail, get_eam_clients, update_eam_client, create_share_link, upload_document, get_email_messages, get_email_detail, link_email_to_client · Destructive: delete_document.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: generate_meeting_brief, get_eam_clients, get_client_dossier, get_client_reviews_due, get_email_messages, get_email_detail · Private data: generate_meeting_brief, list_documents, get_document_detail, get_eam_clients, get_client_dossier, complete_review, delete_document, create_share_link, upload_document, update_document, extract_document_data · Public sink: get_document_detail, get_eam_clients, update_eam_client, create_share_link, upload_document, get_email_messages, get_email_detail, link_email_to_client · Destructive: delete_document

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
